reuse.why: Extracts clearAccountLink from unlinkAccount and reuses it for the replaced holder, and extends the existing assertBankAccountCanBeLinked check shared by all six providers.

duplication.why: The unlink field set now lives in one helper used by both unlinkAccount and the replace path; the only repetition is threading the flag through each provider's link function, which mirrors the existing upgradingId plumbing.

placement.why: The unlink side effect is placed inside a function named and shaped as an assertion (assertBankAccountCanBeLinked), so a validation helper now mutates another account before the link itself is made.

scope.why: Only the flag, the shared helper extraction, the guard change and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Single shared decision point for all providers and a single unlink definition, but the hidden mutation in an assert-named function will surprise maintainers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses assertBankAccountCanBeLinked and the extracted clearAccountLink (also used by unlinkAccount).

disguised_duplication.where: The unlink update was moved into clearAccountLink and the original call site now calls it; nothing is copied.
